# Chest: a wooden chest 0.62 x 0.44 x 0.44 m with a lighter lid, two pale brass bands and a lock.
# Origin: on the floor. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Box --base-color 0.3059 0.2941 0.3529 --no-slot
material new Lid --base-color 0.5490 0.4627 0.3804 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Box --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.160
scale 0.600 0.420 0.320
apply --scale
material assign Box
add mesh cube --name Lid --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.380
scale 0.620 0.440 0.130
apply --scale
material assign Lid
add mesh cube --name BandR --size 1 --location -0.170 0.000 0.240
scale 0.100 0.480 0.500
apply --scale
material assign Band
add mesh cube --name BandL --size 1 --location 0.170 0.000 0.240
scale 0.100 0.480 0.500
apply --scale
material assign Band
add mesh cube --name Lock --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.240 0.300
scale 0.120 0.060 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Band
select all
shade flat
export chest.glb
